A. BOE Nominee for MSBA John T. Belcher Scholarship

fields.Content:
Olli Bekker Vannaman

Congratulations to Olli Bekker Vannaman on being nominated by our district for the Missouri School Boards’ Association (MSBA) John T. Belcher Student Scholarship! Olli will receive a $300 Scholarship from the Center Board of Education and will be entered as a candidate for the Regional Scholarship for $1,000.    The winner of the Regional Scholarship will then be entered to win the Statewide Scholarship for $1,500.

Title: B. CHS Girls Volleyball District 14 Champions

fields.Content:
1. We earned our first trophies at tournaments this year. Varsity got second place at the KCPS Spikefest tournament and JV also got second place at the Grandview JV tournament.
  2. This year we had our first winning records season with a varsity record of 14-11-1 and a JV record of 8-6-2.
  3. All-District 1st Team Members: Icysis Buckle and Margot VanRiette; 2nd Team Members: Takeva Phox and Kim Deleon Hall; Honorable Mention: Ebun Olaoye and Lyrica Porter
  4. All-Conference Team Honorable Mention: Margot VanRiette


Emily Anker, Head Coach
